test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

The new professor is liked by his students for his __amiable__ approach.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4 i.e. 'friendly'.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word "**amiable**" refers to having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner.

 
 
• **Example: **John's amiable nature makes him popular among his peers.
 
 
 
• The correct word "**friendly**" refers to someone who is kind, pleasant, and helpful towards others.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a friendly approach towards teaching, which makes students comfortable to ask questions.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **friendly**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Simple**: This means easily understood or done; presenting no difficulty.

 
 
• **Example**: The instructions were written in a simple and clear manner.
 
 
 
• **Strict**: This means demanding that rules concerning behavior are obeyed and observed.
 
 
• **Example**: The new policy is stricter regarding attendance and punctuality.
 
 
 
• **Academic**: This relates to education and scholarship. 
 
 
• **Example**: Her academic achievements were recognized with several awards.
